description_en: The link points to a CSV file that contains statistics on uplink and downlink data packets of the gateway
description_zh: 该链接指向一个CSV文件，其中包括了网关上下行数据包的统计数据
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan get-gateway-transfer-packets-download-url --iot-instance-id example-string --gw-eui 1514736000000 --dev-eui 0000000000000001 --category DOWNLINK_PACKET --begin-millis 1514736000000 --end-millis 1514736000000 --sorting-field LOG_MILLIS --ascending true --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetGatewayTransferPacketsDownloadUrl

parameters.help_en: The GwEUI of the gateway to query
parameters.name: gw_eui

parameters.help_en:
The data packet category. Valid values:

- **DOWNLINK_PACKET**: downlink packet
- **UPLINK_PACKET**: uplink packet
- **INVALID_PACKET**: invalid packet
parameters.help_zh:
数据包分类。取值：

- **DOWNLINK_PACKET**：下行包
- **UPLINK_PACKET**：上行包
- **INVALID_PACKET**：无效包
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: begin_millis

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: end_millis

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Valid values: **LOG_MILLIS**, which specifies sorting by time
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。取值：**LOG_MILLIS**，表示按照时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en: Used together with the **SortingField** parameter. A value of **true** specifies ascending order, and a value of **false** specifies descending order
